risks.risk: Whether the pump actually inflates effectively (leaks, weak pressure, or damaged seals) cannot be confirmed from the photo.
risks.proof: A short video of the pump inflating a ball/mattress from near-deflated to inflated, showing the nozzle seated properly and no air escaping at joints.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven to work well (assume possible weak/slow inflation).

risks.risk: Compatibility risk: the nozzle/connector may not fit the buyer’s intended items (balls, tyres, inflatable beds).
risks.proof: Show the exact nozzle/adapter(s) included and demonstrate fitting to the buyer’s target item (e.g., ball valve or tyre valve) in a clip.
risks.if_unproven: Priced for general/limited compatibility (assume only one connector type).

risks.risk: Missing parts risk: the photo may not show all adapters, hose length, or the correct connector set.
risks.proof: A photo laid out showing every included piece (hose, nozzle, any adapters) with a count, plus a close-up of the connector end.

proof_requests: Send a short video inflating a common item (ball or inflatable) from low pressure to full, showing no leaks.
Close-up photos of the nozzle/connector end and any adapters included (and confirm what valves it fits).
Confirm whether any parts are missing (hose length, adapters, gauge if any) with a laid-out parts photo.
response.reason: The photo identifies a handheld air pump, but there’s no proof it works, how well it inflates, or what valves/adapters it fits—so a safe worst-case price can’t be set without key evidence.
